name: Coffee Roastery Subscription Profit Analysis
task:
Please complete the following four-stage scenario analysis task.

=== Stage 1: Baseline Calculation ===
A specialty coffee roastery offers a monthly subscription box. They have 2,400 subscribers paying $18/month. Green coffee beans and roasting costs: $14,000/month. Packaging and shipping: $3.50 per box, with an average of 1 box per subscriber per month. Calculate monthly profit.

=== Stage 2: Single-Variable Change ===
Increase social media advertising spend by 25% while keeping other factors constant. Calculate new net revenue.

=== Stage 3: Multi-Variable Change ===
Increase social media advertising spend by 25% AND increase average subscription price by 8%. Calculate new net revenue.

=== Stage 4: Comparison and Recommendation ===
Compare the three scenarios. Recommend the best approach.
